title: Lizzie Miles and the circus at the State Fair
summary: White describes Lizzie's act with white pigeons and his work as Miles's bandmaster splitting the band between the big show and the side show.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: She rode the horse too, or no?

Oh, yes. She rode the horse bareback, I think, with just the flannel over to keep her dress clean, but she was always beautifully gowned. And these pigeons made a perfect pitch out of her, because she was a beautiful woman in those days. And Mr. Jones and the circus would so acclaim her. And with these pigeons, the white pigeons, you know, with a little streak in the wings, lighting on her shoulder, she made a picture, a picture that you couldn't resist looking at. And these were flashing on the billboards, see? So they just flocked to the circus. Now, we're playing the State Fair with Behuma Crill's band.

Uh-huh. And the Cole Brothers Circus was playing there as a special attraction, and Miles has 15 pieces in his band. But I'm Miles' bandmaster, because Miles liked to play the drums to keep the tempo out. So I have to take over for Miles. That's Joel Morris playing there also. And the little Jap Loveless, he's there. And then is when I had to really cut it, because the bulk of the work was on me, playing all of these gallops and fast marches and sailing from one number to another, you know. You're playing the big show now. They had no white band on the show. So then we'd split up and take six pieces and go over and play the side show. They called it the jig show. And the other nine pieces would play in the State Fair and play the circus. I was always with this nine pieces because the bulk of the work was in the Big Ten. Well, when the commissioners came through and I didn't have my registration card with me, why they just said, well, the card was in the, my registration card was in the privileged car now. But they wouldn't allow you to get it because the order was.
